title: Hantaran Dah Bayar
mood: riang di luar, kosong di dalam
subject: pertunangan yang dibatalkan
caption: Irama Malaysia, joget rhythm carried into a modern pop arrangement. Rebana and kompang playing the joget pattern up front, accordion and violin trading the melody, modern bass and a dry kit underneath rather than a traditional gendang only. Bright female lead singing on top of the beat, light ornamentation, no heavy melisma. 132 BPM, D major. Cheerful on the surface, hollow underneath. No EDM, no gamelan sample as decoration, no ballad section, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - rebana and kompang]

[Chorus]
Hantaran dah bayar, pelamin dah tempah
Kad dah cetak lima ratus keping
Semua orang tanya bila
Aku senyum, aku senyum

[Verse 1]
Emak dia telefon emak aku dulu
Bukan dia telefon aku
Tiga hari lepas tu baru dia mesej
Mesej tu pendek, aku baca dua puluh kali

[Chorus]
Hantaran dah bayar, pelamin dah tempah
Kad dah cetak lima ratus keping
Semua orang tanya bila
Aku senyum, aku senyum lagi

[Instrumental Break - accordion and violin]

[Verse 2]
Kad tu aku simpan, tak buang
Nanti kalau ada orang nak buat kad
Boleh tengok contoh
Aku cakap benda ni kuat-kuat supaya bunyi macam munasabah

[Outro - rebana slowing]
Aku senyum lagi
